About

Innovative Product Designer and NID Alumnus with a track record of transforming user problems into market-ready solutions. Proven ability to scale operations, highlighted by founding and leading the Concept Design Department at GM Modular. Diverse experience ranging from consumer electronics (Whirlpool) to high-fidelity prop fabrication for major film studios (Netflix/Disney).

That was mainly about me. Now, how 'Brown' came into existence. Clients' NDAs often prevent me from using the work I've done, but besides that, I like to keep tinkering with that problem-solving designer brain of mine. Under the moniker 'Brown', I make concepts that mostly stem from problems I've run into myself, or things I notice others dealing with, or might have to deal with, in their everyday lives.

Concepts

10 pieces

1TB

2021 — dental care

What if you bought a toothbrush once and just changed the bristles when needed?

1TB keeps the handle for good and replaces only the bristle head. Same brushing habit, a lot less plastic thrown out every few months.

Product designSustainabilityConcept

SPENCER

2021 — kitchen

Why keep the scrub tray and the soap dispenser as two separate objects?

Spencer merges a dish-scrub tray and a soap dispenser into one countertop unit, built for one hand — hold the utensil in one, clean and refill with the other.

Product designKitchenConcept

ETALA

2021 — smart home

An electronic lock that answers the door as well as it opens it.

Unlock by fingerprint, keycard, PIN pad or app. Indoor and outdoor units carry a camera, doorbell and intercom, so you can see who's outside and grant them access from anywhere.

Industrial designSmart homeConcept

VANI-T

2021 — personal care

A design solution to what my grandmother did every day after a shower.

She'd sit in front of a table fan, holding a round mirror up to dry her hair. VANI-T folds that routine into one object — a bladeless fan, a vanity mirror and an LED ring light, sized to a smaller hand.

Product designPersonal careConcept

DRAIER

2022 — personal care

What if one dryer could blow-dry and straighten hair at the same time?

DRAIER fits straightening plates to the nozzle of a hair dryer, folding two steps of a routine into one tool and one motion.

Product designPersonal careConcept

OLLSNAL

2022 — water management

How many times has a bucket or sink overflowed while filling?

An optical liquid-level sensor for a tap or faucet. It reads IR light through the water, and once the level hits the depth you've set, it signals the tap to shut off on its own.

Industrial designSustainabilityConcept

WECKER

2022 — desk object

Not every product needs a niche problem to solve.

An alarm clock and Bluetooth speaker for a desk — something I wanted to have in front of me every morning, nothing more complicated than that.

Product designPersonal objectConcept

ERIC

2023 — mobility

A fully autonomous EV cab, named for what it is — an Electronic (Ric)kshaw.

Each ERIC waits in a dedicated curb space every 100 metres, which doubles as its charging point. Hail one from the app, tap your phone to unlock, tap again to end the trip and pay.

AutomotiveMobilityConcept

PRESHER

2023 — cycling

A foot-paddle air pump already exists for bicycle tyres — why not let it double as a washer?

PRESHER switches between air pump and water wash with a toggle. Its 160 PSI won't match an electric washer's 1500, but it's enough to knock the dust and dirt off a bike after a ride, no outlet required.

Product designCyclingConcept

BEAMER

2023 — home entertainment

Setting up a projector and a speaker for movie night, every time, is a lot of unpacking.

BEAMER merges a 2.1-channel speaker system and a projector into one portable unit, so movie night is one thing to set up and pack away instead of two.

Product designHome entertainmentConcept

Dear Sir/Ma'am,

I am writing to express my interest in freelance Product Design opportunities within your organisation. As a Product Designer and alumnus of the National Institute of Design (NID), Ahmedabad, I bring a diverse background spanning industrial design, consumer products, packaging, UX/UI design, and creative fabrication across multiple industries.

Over the course of my career, I have worked with organisations ranging from Whirlpool and GM Modular to design consultancies such as Landor. My experience includes developing consumer products, creating structural packaging solutions, designing digital user experiences, and leading multidisciplinary teams through the complete product development process.

One of my most significant professional achievements was establishing and leading the Concept Design Department at GM Modular. What began as an individual design role evolved into the creation of a dedicated department where I recruited, trained, and managed a team of designers, engineers, and visualisers. Together, we developed new product lines that expanded the company's market offerings and strengthened its design-led innovation capabilities.

My design approach combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Whether designing a new range of electrical accessories, developing packaging concepts for FMCG brands, creating user flows for digital products, or fabricating high-fidelity props for film productions, I focus on understanding user needs and transforming them into practical, aesthetically compelling solutions.

As a freelancer, I offer versatility across multiple design disciplines, enabling me to contribute effectively at different stages of a project—from concept generation and visualisation to prototyping, refinement, and final execution. My proficiency with Rhino, KeyShot, and the Adobe Creative Suite allows me to communicate ideas clearly and efficiently throughout the design process.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience and design perspective could contribute to your projects. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Sachin Ravindran,
Product Designer.
